player_prompt.intro:
Tllaḍiḍ g uḍay s {num_buttons} ibuttonen: {buttons}. Kraygat button ittuṣṣan s tafḍna n Bernoulli s yan umḍan ibḍan maca ur ittwassnen; imḍannen i buttonen zemren ad illin yemḍanen.
I kraygat button, mi tḍeḍsas-t, rad tawiḍ tifernin i d-yettwaṣṣaṣen seg tafḍna tinṣibin.
Ḍareɣ {num_turns} tikkal n wakud, dɣa, dech kraygat tikkelt n wakud, tzemreḍ ad xṭeḍ button akk d ad tawiḍ tifernin.
Tafukk-kem d ad tzemreḍ ad xṭeḍ buttonen s tɣara yal tikkelt n wakud akken ad tawiḍ talɣut ɣef tafḍna-nsen n tifernin, i d-yetṣṣaḍen-kem ad xṭeḍ button s umḍan meqqren n tifernin s tɣara tamaẓẓant n {num_turns} tikkal.

game_action.pressed: Tkkiḍ tufka n {button} d tufkaɣ-d tajmilt n {reward}.

game_message.final_decision: Tɣaḍiḍ aɣur n tɣawsi n imaynutn n tufkatin d umaynut n tɣawsa nnsnt. Ɣil ad d-ssmriḍ ma d tufka tafullus.
